body:
I started out the night waiting for the E to be delivered around 5 pm I was getting anxious by 7 pm they were here 50 pills, doves to be precise cost us £100 for them I took  one with 3 of my friends and waited roughly an hour before I started feeling anything. By this time my friends were as high as kites so the goods were good. I didnt feel much by this time which wasnt usual although it had been several months since the last time I had taken them. I started to feel good and warm and kinda high and by this time another hour had proceeded so I decided I should take another one and waited to see if I could go any higher but I enjoyed the slight buzz I had but didnt get any higher. Over the course of the next 2 or 3 hours I took another 2 and continued to stay reasonably high but not as high as I remember how good it should be. So I threw caution to the wind and took 2 at once this, when it hit after an hours wait, took me a little higher than earlier so I jumped around feelin good talking nonsense listening to music for about an hour and a half and decided I should just consume the other 2 so I took both of them at once again, but they just prolonged the slight buzz I already had, by this time I was tripping with the walls moving and colours shifting shade and marks on the wall seemingly appearing more obvious.by about 3 or 4 am I was on the downer but still feeling chilled and happy.I noticed that my heart was racing and although the room was very cold I was sweating but I wasnt really worried as I was too chilled.I finally managed to get some sleep and when I awoke in the morning my head was messed up and I was very disorientated and fatigued I could hardly move without feeling very tired, and going to urinate was still very difficult.I noticed that if I concentrated on any object I was still tripping and it would be moving slightly.After the slight dissapointment of not getting to where I wanted to be I would still consider it as a very good night although I may have taken it to the extreme in dosage
